abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Successful Customer Deposit, Withdrawal, and Transaction Verification
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Successful Customer Deposit, Withdrawal, and Transaction Verification
Module: Customer Banking Transactions
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- - User has valid access to the banking application.
- - Ron Weasley is an existing customer with an active account.

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the banking application home page.
2. Wait until the Customer Login button is visible.
3. Click the Customer Login button.
4. Select "Ron Weasley" from the customer dropdown menu.
5. Click the Login button.
6. Wait until the Account Dashboard is displayed.
7. Click the Deposit button.
8. Enter the amount "123456" in the deposit field.
9. Click the Deposit button to confirm.
10. Verify the displayed account balance has increased by 123456.
11. Click the Withdrawal button.
12. Enter the amount "23456" in the withdrawal field.
13. Click the Withdrawal button to confirm.
14. Verify the displayed account balance has decreased by 23456.
15. Click the Transactions button to view transaction history.
16. Verify that both the deposit of 123456 and withdrawal of 23456 are listed with accurate details.
17. Click the Back button to return to the dashboard.
18. Click the Logout button.
19. Verify that the user is redirected to the Customer Login page.

Expected Result:
- - The user is able to login as Ron Weasley successfully.
- - The deposit of 123456 is completed with the account balance increasing accordingly and a success message displayed.
- - The withdrawal of 23456 is completed, decreasing the account balance and displaying a success message.
- - The transaction history accurately lists both the deposit and withdrawal transactions.
- - Logging out redirects the user to the Customer Login page.
